summary: Legs B day. Breakfast and pre-workout stay pure grab-and-go (smoothie, pre-boiled egg, yogurt, almonds for breakfast; bagel, turkey, banana for pre-workout) since he's been skipping both and lifting fasted - no prep needed anywhere. Lunch leans into the chicken-breast-and-egg-and-pasta combo he built himself on his last custom plate. Dinner uses Marys Korean Style Spicy Chicken for variety and extra carbs on this leg day, topped up with turkey and black beans for protein and fiber.
